name: dloop
description: DLoop delivery workflow with an explicitly selected Unity UI planning configuration.

interface.shortDescription: Run DLoop or its explicit Unity UI planning configuration.
interface.longDescription: DLoop manages the delivery archive and approvals. When explicitly selected, the bundled DloopUI skill completes interaction details during implementation and presents the delivery for final user acceptance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $dloop for the standard delivery workflow, or $dloop-ui for the explicit Unity UI planning configuration.
